summary: Tested Stripe Issuing dispatcher for /api/virtual-cards with STRIPE_ISSUING_ENABLED=false. 12/13 pytest tests passed. Mock fallback path works correctly (is_stripe:false, 16-digit PAN, VC- prefix, exp 12/2027). Direct /api/issuing/* endpoints still gated with 503. Webhook without signature returns 400. Admin auth + regression endpoints (/api/admin/stats, /api/auctions/active, /api/wallet, /api/wallet/balance/total, /api/auth/me) all green. One real validation bug found for limit=0.

critical.issue: limit=0 bypasses validation and returns 200 with default €50 card instead of HTTP 400. Root cause in /app/backend/routes/premium_finance.py line ~193: `limit_eur = float(body.get('limit') or 50.0)` — 0 is falsy in Python, so `0 or 50.0` silently substitutes 50.0 before the `< 1` check. Same risk with limit=None/null/missing (intended default, OK) but 0 should be explicit rejection per spec ('zwischen €1 und €5.000').

action_items: Fix limit=0 validation in /app/backend/routes/premium_finance.py:193. Replace `limit_eur = float(body.get('limit') or 50.0)` with `raw = body.get('limit'); limit_eur = float(raw) if raw is not None else 50.0` — then the existing `if limit_eur < 1` guard will properly reject 0.

rca of the issue: POST /api/virtual-cards {limit:0} → expected 400, got 200. RCA: `float(body.get('limit') or 50.0)` in premium_finance.py line 193 — Python's `or` short-circuits on falsy values including 0, so limit=0 is replaced with default 50.0 BEFORE the range check. Reproduction: `curl -X POST .../api/virtual-cards -H 'Cookie: access_token=...' -d '{"label":"x","limit":0}'` returns 200. Mitigation: `raw = body.get('limit'); limit_eur = float(raw) if raw is not None else 50.0`.
